audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Deliverance, death, Sheol, vows, sacrifice, faithful death, and gratitude.

verses.restored: I love YHWH, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

familiar.text: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

modern.text: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.

original.text: אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּֽי יִשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֑ה אֶת ק֝וֹלִ֗י תַּחֲנוּנָֽי

verses.restored: Because he hath inclined his ear to me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

familiar.text: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

modern.text: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.

original.text: כִּֽי הִטָּ֣ה אָזְנ֣וֹ לִ֑י וּבְיָמַ֥י אֶקְרָֽא

verses.restored: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

familiar.text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

modern.text: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.

original.text: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי חֶבְלֵי מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא

verses.restored: Then called I upon the name of YHWH; O YHWH, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

familiar.text: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

modern.text: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”

original.text: וּבְשֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי

verses.restored: Gracious is YHWH, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

familiar.text: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

modern.text: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

verses.restored: YHWH preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

familiar.text: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

modern.text: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.

original.text: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ

verses.restored: Return to thy rest, O my soul; for YHWH hath dealt bountifully with thee.

familiar.text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

modern.text: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.

original.text: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי

verses.restored: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

familiar.text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

modern.text: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.

original.text: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת עֵינִ֥י מִן דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי

verses.restored: I will walk before YHWH in the land of the living.

familiar.text: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

modern.text: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

verses.restored: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

familiar.text: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

modern.text: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”

original.text: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד

verses.restored: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

familiar.text: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

modern.text: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”

familiar.text: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

modern.text: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?

original.text: מָֽה אָשִׁ֥יב לַיהוָ֑ה כָּֽל תַּגְמוּל֥וֹהִי עָלָֽי

familiar.text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.

modern.text: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.

original.text: כּוֹס יְשׁוּע֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֑א וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא

verses.restored: I will pay my vows to YHWH now in the presence of all his people.

familiar.text: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.

modern.text: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.

original.text: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה נָּ֝֗א לְכָל עַמּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Precious in the eyes of YHWH is the death of his faithful ones.

familiar.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

notes.title: Precious is the death
notes.body: This line values the lives and deaths of God’s faithful ones; it must not be romanticized into a reason to seek death, martyrdom, or self-harm.

modern.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.

verses.restored: O YHWH, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

familiar.text: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

modern.text: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Death language must not romanticize martyrdom or self-harm; continuing life and gratitude are central to the psalm.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
